test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 12 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which Article of the Constitution of India prohibits the State from discriminating against the use of wells, tanks and places of public entertainment?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Article 15**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Article 15** of the **Constitution of India** prohibits the state from discriminating against any citizen on grounds of **religion, race, caste, sex, or place of birth.**
 
• The second clause of **Article 15(2)** specifically prohibits discrimination in accessing **shops, public restaurants, hotels, and places of public entertainment**, as well as the use of **wells, tanks, bathing ghats, roads, and places of public resort maintained wholly or partly by State funds.**
 
• This article aims to ensure **equality** and abolish all forms of social discrimination that restrict access to public amenities.
 
• It is part of the **Fundamental Rights** under the Constitution, emphasizing equality and safeguarding the rights of marginalized groups.
 
• The provision ensures the promotion of an **inclusive society**, fostering harmony and equal opportunity for all citizens of India.
 
• It reflects the core values of **justice, equality, and fraternity** enshrined in the **Preamble of the Constitution.**
 
• This article plays a crucial role in reducing the practices of untouchability and other forms of discrimination in Indian society.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Article 18**__

 __
 
• **Article 18** deals with the **abolition of titles**, except for academic and military distinctions.
 
• It prohibits the state from conferring titles and prevents Indian citizens from accepting titles from a foreign state.
 
• This article ensures the principle of equality and eliminates any form of aristocracy.
 
 
 
• **Article 17**__
 __
 
• **Article 17** abolishes **untouchability** and forbids its practice in any form.
 
• It is a significant provision aimed at eradicating caste-based discrimination in Indian society.
 
• Any act of untouchability is an **offense** punishable under law.
 
 
 
• **Article 16**__
 
 
• **Article 16** guarantees **equality of opportunity** in matters of public employment.
 
• It prohibits discrimination in public employment on the grounds of **religion, race, caste, sex, descent, place of birth, or residence.**
 
• The article, however, allows for **reservation policies** for socially and educationally backward classes, Scheduled Castes, and Scheduled Tribes.
